description: Practice interviews (Premium): create, change and delete setups and questions, and start, answer, finish, score and delete practice sessions. Actions: create_setup, update_setup, delete_setup, create_question, update_question, delete_question, start_session, answer, finish_session, cancel_session, score_session, delete_session. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

question_id.description: A practice question's id from get_interview_practice overview (questions[].id).

session_id.description: A practice session's id from get_interview_practice overview (sessions[].id) or manage_interview_practice start_session.

setup_id.description: A practice setup's id from get_interview_practice overview (setups[].id).

name: manage_interview_practice
title: Run interview practice
